shot_brief: 9.5s logo sting, two scenes, one motif: the loop becomes the brand. SCENE 1 (0-3.6s, hand-authored): terminal card types '$ pi corrige el test roto' with blinking block caret; the prompt dissolves as the agentic loop draws on (solid mint ring over faint dashed guide), 4 nodes punch in (RAZONA, ACTUA, OBSERVA, CORRIGE) with pi glyph at center, pulse orbits the ring; the whole loop collapses into center. SCENE 2 (3.3-4.3s flash, then logo-outro 3.6-9.5s): mint flash burst bridges; wordmark assembles piece by piece with glow bloom and underline sweep; tagline word-reveals; glass pill fades up; hold with breathing.
